Care & Delivery

Care Guide
Vacuum using suction only on low setting keeping clear of the fringe. Never use a rotating beater bar, which can pull tufts loose from the adhesive backing. Blot spills immediately and avoid soaking or steam cleaning since excess moisture can weaken or crack the latex backing over time. Spot clean with a mild detergent and minimal water. For deep cleaning please use professional cleaners. Rotate every 6 months for even wear.

Buying Guide
This rug is made using a tufting gun that punches yarn loops through a canvas backing, which is then secured with a latex adhesive layer and a secondary layer of canvas. The loops are sheared to provide a soft, medium pile. Some shedding of loose fibres is normal in the first few months and eases with regular low-suction vacuuming. New rugs may carry a mild latex odour that dissipates within 1–2 weeks of airing. We do our best to show our rug colours and designs accurately, though slight variations may occur due to screen settings and lighting conditions.

Hand-woven vs Hand-tufted

Hand-woven:
Hand-woven rugs are created by interlacing warp and weft threads on a loom, producing a flat, reversible design with no pile. This traditional method highlights craftsmanship and durability.

Hand-tufted:
Hand-tufted rugs are made by punching yarn into a backing material with a tufting tool, then securing it with fabric and glue. The result is a plush, textured rug that feels soft underfoot.

Care/Cleaning Instructions

You’ve chosen a rug made with care and craftsmanship. With a little care at home, it will stay soft, beautiful, and part of your home for many years to come. Here’s your simple guide to keeping it at its best.

Do not iron

Blot spills immediately with clean, dry cloth.

Do not dry clean

Avoid direct sunlight

Vacuum without the beater bar turned on

Do not bleach

Rug Thickness /Pile Height

Pile height refers to the thickness of a rug’s fibres, measured from the surface to the backing.
Medium pile rugs (0.6–1.2 cm) have a soft, cushioned feel while remaining easy to care for—making them a versatile choice for medium- to high-traffic areas like living rooms and dining spaces.

Meet The Makers

Every FableRoom rug is handcrafted by skilled artisans in India. Our craftspeople have mastered traditional weaving techniques passed down through generations. We work closely with our makers to ensure each rug is crafted with precision, integrity and care. The result is timeless texture and warmth, designed to bring comfort and character to every home.

Everything You Need To Know

We've reimagined how quality furniture and home décor reach you. We work directly with skilled makers who maintain fair wages and follow sustainable practices and thereby cut out middlemen. This enables us to offer at least 30% savings in the form of lower prices on most of our products, and often even more.

Every piece is sourced from carefully vetted makers who use premium materials and traditional techniques. Many of our artisans have been perfecting their craft for generations, creating pieces built to last - not just look good in photos.

Most of our products are handcrafted by skilled Artisans in India, utilizing their expertise in traditional techniques passed down through generations, while a few of our collections are sourced from Vietnam.
